ios.desc:
Follow the anime you watch each week. See what's airing, keep track of your episodes, and add scheduled reminders with Aira Premium.

Aira is a season-first anime tracker: no social feed, no ads, and no subscription.

START TRACKING FOR FREE

• Browse the current anime season.
• Check what airs today and this week.
• Update your episode progress with one tap.
• Connect MyAnimeList to keep your list and progress in sync, or continue without logging in.

EPISODE REMINDERS WITH PREMIUM

A one-time Aira Premium purchase unlocks episode reminders for currently airing shows you're watching.

Reminders are scheduled on your device using each show's known weekly airing day and time. Turn them on in Settings and allow notifications to receive them.

Reminders follow the airing schedule, not streaming-service availability. Shows without a known weekly airing time cannot have a reminder scheduled.

ALSO INCLUDED WITH PREMIUM

• Advanced filters — narrow down anime by studio, source, and format.
• Custom calendar views — switch between list and week views.
• Pin favorites — keep your top shows at the front.
• Hide completed and dropped shows — keep your library focused.

One purchase unlocks the Premium features. No recurring subscription.

MYANIMELIST INTEGRATION

Aira uses official MyAnimeList login. Your password is never shared with the app. Signing in is optional.

Privacy policy: https://airaapp.kulman.sk/privacy

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’ve been watching anime for years and tracking everything on MyAnimeList. Over time I noticed that most tracking apps (including the official one) became noisy — ads, subscriptions, social features, recommendations, and a lot of UI I didn’t want.

These days I mostly watch seasonal anime week by week. What I actually need is very simple:
- What is airing this season
- What airs today
- A quick way to mark episodes as watched

So I built Aira, a small iOS app focused purely on seasonal anime.

Design goals:
- No ads, no subscriptions
- No backend, works offline
- No tracking or analytics
- Can be used without a MyAnimeList account (login is optional)

It uses the MyAnimeList API for data and OAuth for optional sync, but the app itself stores everything locally.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/aira-seasonal-anime-tracker/id6756657581

Mini site: https://airaapp.kulman.sk
